{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Skyrun Station''' was located near the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aduba-5]],<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|The Hidden Merchants}}</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Aduba system/Legends|Aduba system]]</ref> During the [[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Weapon/Legends|arms]] bazaar was held somewhere among the moons of Aduba-5.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Hidden Merchants" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual associated with one of the two rival factions sent a companion to Skyrun Station. The companion examined the station's logs in order to discover clues as to the whereabouts of the criminals hosting the bazaar. After using the logs to find the bazaar's location, they comandeered the systems of the criminals.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Skyrun Station was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "The Hidden Merchants" of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
